_about: Thermal properties of wire insulation materials used by cable_thermal.wires. k = thermal conductivity [W/(m K)], density [kg/m3], cp = specific heat [J/(kg K)]. Constant (room-temperature) values unless model = paper_curves. Steady-state ampacity depends on k only; density and cp only affect transients. Retrieved 2026-11-05.

_sources.paper: Riba & Llaurado, Materials 2022, 15, 6814, Figs. 2-3 (digitized curves, 20-75 degC)
_sources.fluorotherm: Fluorotherm, 'All Material Comparison - Typical Properties of Fluoropolymers', https://www.fluorotherm.com/technical-information/materials-overview/material-comparison/ (specific gravity ASTM D792, thermal conductivity)
_sources.fluororesin_table: 'Table 4.15 Fluororesin characteristics list (representative values)', JIS/ISO/ASTM methods, https://cdn.toxicdocs.org/Jr/JroRLGB0ekO497EBkRmM6erQ6/JroRLGB0ekO497EBkRmM6erQ6.pdf (specific heat JIS K 7123, density, conductivity)
_sources.arkema_kynar740: Arkema, KYNAR 740 technical data sheet, https://hpp.arkema.com/assets/arkema/TDS_KYNAR%C2%AE%20740_en_WW.pdf (k 0.17-0.19 W/m-K ASTM D433, density 1.77-1.79 g/cm3)
_sources.shinetsu: Shin-Etsu, 'Characteristic properties of silicone rubber compounds', https://www.shinetsusilicone-global.com/catalog/pdf/rubber_e.pdf ('thermal conductivity of silicone rubber is about 0.2 W/m K')
_sources.momentive_rtv615: Momentive RTV615 data sheet, https://static.datasheets.com/doc/2413966-momentive-performance-materials-rtv615-010-ds.pdf (specific heat 0.3 cal/g degC = 1256 J/kg K; k 0.00045 cal/s cm degC = 0.19 W/m K)
_sources.tym_silicone: TYM Seals & Gaskets, silicone rubber sheet data sheet, https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1087/2094/files/Silicone_Rubber_Sheet_Data_Sheet.pdf (density SG 1.2, k 0.24)
_sources.sabic_noryl_v0150b: SABIC NORYL V0150B (PPE+HIPS) data sheet, https://static.datasheets.com/doc/17156510-saudi-basic-industries-v0150b-ds.pdf (k 0.27 W/m-degC ISO 8302, specific gravity 1.11)
_sources.ensinger_tecanyl_gf30: Ensinger TECANYL GF30 (PPE, glass filled) data sheet, https://www.polymershapes.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/Polymershapes_Ensinger_DataSheet-TECANYL-GF30-natural.pdf (specific heat 1.2 J/(g K) and k 0.28 W/(K m), ISO 22007-4; glass-filled PPE grade)
_sources.iec: IEC 60287-2-1 (thermal resistivity of EPR insulation 3.5 K m/W) and IEC 60853-2 (volumetric specific heat of EPR 2.0e6 J/(m3 K)) - standard values, not re-downloaded in this session

PVC.note: paper Fig. 3c: 0.142 W/m K at 20 degC falling to 0.113 at 75 degC (held constant above). IEC 60287 uses 0.20 (rho_T = 5 K m/W).

fluoropolymer_unspecified.note: Alpha ThermoThin 'FLUOROPLASTIC' (type not disclosed): mean of PTFE/FEP/PFA/ETFE conductivities (0.19-0.25), density and cp of PTFE/FEP/PFA

silicone_rubber.note: filled HCR wire compounds: k 0.2-0.24 (TYM 0.24), RTV615 (unfilled) 0.19

mPPE.note: modified PPE (PPE blend). Alpha EcoWire compound itself is not characterised publicly; cp from a glass-filled PPE grade (best available)

EPR.note: k = 1/3.5; density x cp = 2.0e6 J/(m3 K) (only the product matters)

mapping_notes.PTFE TAPE: tape-wrapped PTFE modelled as solid PTFE (voids would lower k)
mapping_notes.MPPE-TPE: mPPE/TPE blend modelled with mPPE properties
mapping_notes.NYLON: thin nylon over-layer of THHN (0.005 in) modelled with PVC properties - no nylon data sourced
mapping_notes.Mica Glass Tape: no thermal property data found - parts not simulated
mapping_notes.PTFE Impregnated Fiberglass: no thermal property data found - parts not simulated
